text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking with Mejiro Dober—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Dober! You got here at just the right 
time!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was just on my way to see Dober right 
now~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Fine and Hishi Ama-san? Did something 
happen?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of having another dark-pot 
tea party like we did before. What do you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Urk... *that*...?
choice_data_list: What's a Mystery Hot Pot Tea Time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Earlier... Fine invited me, and we ended 
up having a tea party, but—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's make a lovely mystery hot 
pot that pairs wonderfully with black tea, 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Normally, wouldn't it be chiffon cake or 
cookies? What even is a dark pot mystery 
stew that pairs with black tea...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It sounds fun, like making a magic 
potion! Let's toss in all kinds of 
things!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on...! Don't push yourself too 
hard...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This is my first time having yaminabe. We 
never did that sort of thing in the Mejiro 
family...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! I'm sure it'll make a 
wonderful four-leaf clover of memories!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Who brought the most interesting 
ingredient, I wonder? Let the Yaminabe 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup begin! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I-It looks pretty poisonous now, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What's this? Rainbow-colored candy...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's Sweepy's Special Magical Candy!☆ You 
can enjoy seven wondrous flavors—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It was supposed to be sweet! What's with 
this bitter seed!? It completely ruined 
the candy flavor!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Are those my ingredients? Ardan-san shared 
some of her medicinal herb stock with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Also, Ryan gave me some protein powder, so 
I need to take that too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Waah~! Looks super healthy~♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm starting to feel like my macarons 
are the most normal ones here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... Come to think of it, Fine, what did 
you put in?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Me? As for me~... black pudding♪

text_block_list.name: The Other Three
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—After that, there was a huge fuss about 
the strange smell, and Hishi Ama gave us 
an earful...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There was weird smoke billowing out of the 
kitchen, and all the girls around were 
knocked flat on their backs—I was so 
shocked!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, Hishi Ama-neesan is joining in this 
time, so nothing like before is gonna 
happen!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's it! This time, let's make an 
interesting and delicious mystery hot pot♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What should I do...? Hishi Ama-san is 
there, so I think it'll be fine, butâ
choice_data_list:
Let's gather the ingredients, then! Strike 
while the iron is hot!
Go on and have fun making memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-Why are you so into this...?
choice_data_list:
Dober won't lose to the others even in a 
mystery hot pot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, obviously I'm not gonna slack off 
once I'm in, but me winning the whole 
thing is...
choice_data_list:
Dober won't lose to the others even in a 
mystery hot pot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... Jeez, stop talking nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pfft, what's with that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
For now, I'll go to the shopping street 
and buy some delicious, interesting 
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
For now, I'll go to the shopping street 
and buy some delicious, interesting 
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—while the second dark mystery hot pot 
didn't cause a foul odor incident, it 
apparently tasted completely disastrous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro Dober, who had reached the 
pinnacle of the Yaminabe's Queen Cup, 
looked strangely satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I was actually thinking of doing 
some solo training today, though...”
choice_data_list:
You gotta enjoy the races and everything 
else too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What's with that...? Acting all parental 
all of a sudden.
choice_data_list:
Hanging out with friends is the best part 
of student life, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Is that how it works?
choice_data_list:
Hanging out with friends is the best part 
of student life, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, yeah. Well, I'm heading out 
now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Then, I'll go play... for just a 
little bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—while the second dark mystery hot pot 
didn't cause a foul odor incident, it 
apparently tasted completely disastrous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—while the second dark mystery hot pot 
didn't cause a foul odor incident, it 
apparently tasted completely disastrous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, as Mejiro Dober recounted the 
whole story, her expression looked truly 
joyful."
